plan.problem: The Change Execution OS has reached the point where further identity and attestation hardening would exceed the practical needs of Yumaniwa Town and risk making the control system itself the project.

plan.design: Make no code changes. Add an explicit closure section to CHANGE-VERIFICATION.md and OPERATIONS.md describing the completed trust boundary, intentionally deferred features, the meaning of UNVERIFIED, and the condition under which Change Execution OS work should resume.

Leave the status implicit; future work could mistakenly resume the deferred C3-3 path as if it were required.

plan.compatibility: No runtime, CI, ruleset, registry, verifier, production, or release behavior changes.
